content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Sometimes, when I remove analog signal connections in a function block diagram to make the diagram clearer, these signals stop updating as expected. If I reconnect them, functionality returns to normal. This issue does not happen with digital signals. I'm using [product_name] [product_name] V8.0.0.

Hi, I've also noticed this issue when removing links between parameters—a feature introduced in a recent [version_no]. Essentially, two block parameters are connected using page markers. From my experience, this problem tends to surface when handling a large number of blocks (around 120) across multiple pages. Could you let me know approximately how many blocks you have in your project and how many pages your page markers span? Sharing a screenshot of the issue might also help. My recommendation is to avoid page markers for analog signals and use them only for digital signals. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are experiencing issues in [product_name] [product_name] V8 with analog signals in function block diagrams. Disconnecting and reconnecting these signals can cause analog values to stop updating, while digital signals remain unaffected. The problem seems connected to the use of page markers, especially in projects with many blocks spread across several pages. This suggests a potential bug in handling analog signals routed via page markers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect analog signal paths in function block diagrams to remain reliable after editing, with proper signal updates, similar to digital signals, regardless of diagram structure changes.
